items.title: Sam's Saturday
items.text: On Saturday, Sam woke up at eight o'clock. First, he ate toast and an egg for breakfast. Then he cleaned his room and did his homework. In the afternoon, he played soccer with his friends in the park. After that, he went home and took a shower. In the evening, he watched a movie with his family and went to bed at ten.

qs.q: What did Sam do right after breakfast?
o: He played soccer in the park.
He took a shower at home.
He watched a movie with his family.
qs.why: 아침을 먹은 다음(Then) 방 청소를 하고 숙제를 했어요.

qs.q: Where did Sam play soccer?
qs.why: in the park라고 나와 있어요.

qs.q: What time did Sam go to bed?
qs.why: 마지막 문장에 went to bed at ten이라고 나와요. eight는 일어난 시각이에요.

qs.q: Which thing did Sam do before he played soccer?
qs.why: 숙제는 오후에 축구를 하기 전에 했어요. 나머지는 모두 축구 뒤에 한 일이에요.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: What Sam did on a Saturday
How to make toast and eggs
qs.why: 토요일에 샘이 하루 동안 한 일을 순서대로 말하는 글이에요.

items.title: A Rainy Day
items.text: It was raining all morning, so Mina could not go to the park. She felt a little sad at first. Then her mother gave her paper and colored pencils. Mina drew a big rainbow and a yellow sun. When she finished, the rain stopped. She hung the picture on the window and smiled.

qs.q: Why couldn't Mina go to the park?
o: She had to clean her room.
Her mother was away from home.
The park was closed for repair.
qs.why: 첫 문장에서 비가 와서 공원에 갈 수 없었다고 해요.

qs.q: How did Mina feel at first?
qs.why: 처음에는 a little sad(조금 슬픈) 기분이었어요.

qs.q: What did Mina draw?
qs.why: 큰 무지개와 노란 해를 그렸다고 나와요.

qs.q: What did Mina do with the picture at the end?
o: She gave it to her mother.
She put it on the window.
She sent it to a friend.
She put it in her bag.
qs.why: hung the picture on the window, 즉 그림을 창문에 걸었어요.

items.title: Our School Garden
items.text: Our class has a small garden behind the school. Every Monday, we water the plants. In spring we planted tomatoes, carrots, and beans. Last week, we picked the first tomatoes and shared them at lunch. Mr. Park says a garden teaches us to be patient because plants grow slowly. I love our garden.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
o: A farm in a big city
qs.why: 학교 텃밭에서 하는 일과 그 의미를 이야기하는 글이에요.

qs.q: When do the students water the plants?
qs.why: Every Monday라고 나와 있어요.

qs.q: Which vegetable did the class NOT plant?
qs.why: 토마토, 당근, 콩을 심었다고 나오고 감자는 나오지 않아요.

qs.q: In “shared them at lunch,” what does “them” mean?
qs.why: 앞 문장에서 딴 first tomatoes를 점심에 나눠 먹었어요.

qs.q: Why does Mr. Park say a garden teaches patience?
o: Plants need a lot of water
qs.why: 식물이 천천히 자라기 때문에 기다릴 줄 알게 된다고 했어요.

items.title: Grandmother's Kitchen
items.text: My grandmother lives in Daegu. When I visit her, I always help her in the kitchen. She makes kimchi stew with pork and tofu, and the smell fills the whole house. She never uses a recipe book. She says she remembers every step in her heart. After dinner, she tells me stories about her childhood.

qs.q: Where does the writer's grandmother live?
qs.why: 첫 문장에 My grandmother lives in Daegu라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does the grandmother NOT use when she cooks?
qs.why: She never uses a recipe book이라고 했어요. 돼지고기, 두부, 김치는 찌개 재료예요.

qs.q: What does “the smell fills the whole house” mean?
qs.why: 냄새가 집 전체에 퍼질 만큼 강하다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What does the grandmother do after dinner?
o: She goes out to buy some food
She sits down to read the news
She tells stories to the writer
She starts to wash all the dishes
qs.why: 저녁 식사 뒤에 어린 시절 이야기를 들려줘요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the grandmother?
qs.why: 레시피 없이 모든 단계를 기억한다는 것은 오랫동안 요리해 왔다는 뜻이에요.

items.title: Lost Umbrella
items.text: Lost Umbrella! Hello, everyone. I lost my blue umbrella with white dots on Tuesday. I think I left it on the number 7 bus after school, but I am not sure. The handle has a small yellow bird sticker on it. It was a present from my aunt, so it is very special to me. If you find it, please bring it to Hana in Room 5-3. Thank you!

qs.q: Why did Hana write this notice?
o: To say sorry to a teacher
qs.why: 잃어버린 우산을 찾으려고 쓴 안내문이에요.

qs.q: Where does Hana think she left it?
qs.why: I think I left it on the number 7 bus라고 했어요.

qs.q: Which detail can help people know her umbrella?
o: It is red with black stripes.
It has a long silver chain.
It is very big and green.
It has a bird sticker on the handle.
qs.why: 손잡이에 노란 새 스티커가 있다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why is the umbrella special to Hana?
o: She won it in a contest.
She bought it with her savings.
Her aunt gave it to her.
qs.why: 이모(고모)가 준 선물이라서 특별하다고 했어요.

items.title: Library Rules
items.text: Our school library is open from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. on school days. You can borrow up to three books for one week. Please speak quietly so everyone can read in peace. Food is not allowed, and drinks must stay in your bag. If you want to keep a book longer, ask the librarian before the due date. Thank you for keeping our library nice!

qs.q: What is the largest number of books a student can borrow?
qs.why: up to three books, 최대 세 권이에요.

qs.q: What should students do to keep a book longer?
qs.why: 기간을 늘리려면 반납일 전에 사서 선생님께 물어봐야 해요.

qs.q: Which thing is allowed in the library?
qs.why: 조용히 말하는 것만 허용돼요. 음식은 안 되고 음료는 가방에 두어야 해요.

qs.q: What is the purpose of this text?
o: To explain how books are made
To describe a trip to a library
qs.why: 도서관 이용 규칙을 알려 주는 글이에요.

qs.q: Until what time is the library open?
qs.why: from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.이라고 나와요.

items.title: A Trip to Jeju
items.text: Last summer, Jina visited Jeju Island with her family. They took a plane from Seoul, and the flight was only one hour. On the first day, they climbed a small hill and saw green fields and the sea. Jina ate fresh fish every day. It was windy on the island, so she wore a jacket even in summer. She wants to go there again next year.

qs.q: How did Jina's family travel to Jeju?
qs.why: They took a plane from Seoul이라고 나와요.

qs.q: What did Jina see from the hill?
o: A busy market and a port
qs.why: 푸른 들판과 바다를 봤다고 해요.

qs.q: Why did Jina wear a jacket?
qs.why: 섬에 바람이 많이 불어서 여름에도 재킷을 입었어요.

qs.q: What does Jina want to do?
qs.why: 내년에 다시 가고 싶어 해요.

items.title: Penguins
items.text: Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly. Their wings are short and strong, so they use them like paddles in the water. Penguins eat fish and small sea animals. Many penguins live in very cold places, and they stay warm with thick feathers and a layer of fat. On land, they walk slowly, but in the water, they are fast swimmers.

qs.q: What is the passage mainly about?
qs.why: 펭귄의 생활과 헤엄 등 특징을 소개하는 글이에요.

qs.q: What do penguins use their wings for in the water?
qs.why: 날개를 노처럼 써서 헤엄친다고 했어요.

qs.q: What keeps penguins warm?
qs.why: 두꺼운 깃털과 지방층 덕분에 따뜻해요.

qs.q: Which statement is true?
qs.why: 펭귄은 물속에서 빠른 수영 선수예요.

items.title: A Birthday Email
items.text: Hi Emma, Thank you for coming to my birthday party on Saturday. I had a great time! I loved the puzzle you gave me, and I finished it with my dad yesterday. It had five hundred pieces, so it took us two hours. Next weekend, I want to invite you to my house to play a board game. Can you come? Your friend, Leo

qs.q: Why did Leo write this email?
qs.why: 생일 파티에 와 준 것에 고마워하고 다음 주말에 초대하려고 썼어요.

qs.q: What did Emma give Leo?
qs.why: I loved the puzzle you gave me라고 했어요.

qs.q: How long did Leo and his dad take to finish it?
qs.why: it took us two hours라고 나와요. five hundred는 조각 수예요.

qs.q: What does Leo want Emma to do next weekend?
o: Come to his house to play
Meet him at a movie theater
Help him study at the library
Bake a cake for his dad
qs.why: 다음 주말에 집에 와서 보드게임을 하자고 했어요.

items.title: The Recycling Club
items.text: Our school has a recycling club. Every Friday, club members collect paper, cans, and plastic bottles from each classroom. Then they put them in different boxes. The club also makes small notebooks from used paper. Last month, the club collected 120 kilograms of paper. Everyone in the club hopes more students will join.

qs.q: When do club members collect things?
qs.why: Every Friday라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does the club make from used paper?
qs.why: 쓴 종이로 작은 공책을 만든다고 했어요.

qs.q: How much paper did the club collect last month?
qs.why: 120 kilograms of paper라고 나와요.

qs.q: What does the club hope?
o: The school will get a new gym
qs.why: 더 많은 학생이 가입하기를 바란다고 마지막 문장에 나와요.

items.title: The New Bike
items.text: Ben got a new bike for his birthday, but he was afraid to ride it. His legs shook when he sat on the seat. His older sister Yuri held the back of the bike and said, "Don't worry. I won't let go." Ben began to pedal slowly. After ten minutes, he looked back. Yuri was far behind, and he was riding alone! He laughed loudly.

qs.q: How did Ben feel when he first sat on the bike?
qs.why: 처음에는 타기를 무서워했고 다리가 떨렸어요.

qs.q: What does Yuri mean by "I won't let go"?
o: She will keep holding the bike.
She will ride next to him.
She will buy him a helmet.
qs.why: 뒤에서 자전거를 계속 잡아 주겠다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What can we guess about Yuri?
o: She could not ride a bike.
She let go of the bike.
qs.why: 벤이 뒤돌아보니 유리가 멀리 뒤에 있었으므로 자전거를 놓았다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: Why did Ben laugh loudly?
o: He had fallen down on the road.
He lost the way back home.
qs.why: 혼자 자전거를 타고 있다는 것을 알고 기뻐서 웃었어요.

items.title: Healthy Habits
items.text: Doctor Kim visited our class to talk about healthy habits. She said we should sleep at least nine hours every night, because tired children cannot learn well. She also told us to wash our hands before meals and to eat vegetables every day. Finally, she asked us to play outside for an hour. "Moving your body makes you strong," she said.

qs.q: Why did Doctor Kim visit the class?
qs.why: 건강한 습관에 대해 이야기하러 왔어요.

qs.q: Why should students sleep at least nine hours?
o: So they can watch more TV
So they can walk to school
qs.why: 피곤한 아이들은 잘 배우지 못하기 때문이에요.

qs.q: When should students wash their hands?
qs.why: 식사 전에 손을 씻으라고 했어요.

qs.q: Which advice did Doctor Kim NOT give?
qs.why: 우유 이야기는 없었어요. 나머지는 모두 조언한 내용이에요.

items.title: Bobo the Robot
items.text: In Minho's classroom, there is a small robot named Bobo. Bobo cannot walk, but it can talk and answer questions. When students ask about the weather, Bobo checks the Internet and tells them in a clear voice. Bobo also reads short stories aloud. Minho likes Bobo, but he thinks it is not a real teacher because it cannot understand feelings.

qs.q: What can Bobo do?
qs.why: 걷지는 못하지만 말하고 질문에 대답할 수 있어요.

qs.q: How does Bobo know the weather?
qs.why: 인터넷을 확인해서 알려 줘요.

qs.q: In “reads short stories aloud,” what does “aloud” mean?
qs.why: aloud는 소리 내어라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does Minho think Bobo is not a real teacher?
qs.why: 로봇은 감정을 이해하지 못하기 때문이라고 했어요.

items.title: Hanbok Day
items.text: Every October, our school has Hanbok Day. Students come to school in colorful hanbok, and we take pictures in the schoolyard. In the morning, we learn how to bow politely to our teachers. At lunch, we eat tteok and drink a sweet rice drink. This year, an exchange student from another country, Anna, joined us. She wore a pink hanbok and said it was lighter than she thought.

qs.q: When does the school have Hanbok Day?
qs.why: Every October라고 나와요.

qs.q: What do students learn in the morning?
qs.why: 선생님께 공손히 절하는 법을 배워요.

qs.q: Who is Anna?
qs.why: 다른 나라에서 온 교환 학생이에요.

qs.q: What did Anna think of the hanbok?
o: It was lighter than she thought.
It was heavier than she thought.
It was too small for her.
It was too hot to wear.
qs.why: 생각보다 가벼웠다고 말했어요.

items.title: Spring Fun Run
items.text: Spring Fun Run! Join us at Green Hill Park on April 20. The run starts at 9:30 a.m. There are two courses: a short run for children under twelve and a long run for adults. Everyone gets a free T-shirt and some water. Tickets for children cost 5,000 won. Please register at the school office by April 15.

qs.q: What time does the run start?
qs.why: The run starts at 9:30 a.m.이라고 나와요.

qs.q: Who runs the short course?
qs.why: 짧은 코스는 열두 살 미만 어린이를 위한 거예요.

qs.q: What does everyone get for free?
qs.why: 모두에게 무료 티셔츠와 물을 줘요.

qs.q: By when should people register?
qs.why: April 15일까지 학교 사무실에서 등록해야 해요. April 20은 행사 날이에요.

items.title: Busy Bees
items.text: Bees are small insects, but they work very hard. A group of bees lives together in a hive. Some bees fly out to find flowers and bring back a sweet juice called nectar. Other bees stay inside and make it into honey. While bees visit flowers, they also help plants make seeds and fruit. Without bees, we would have less fruit, such as apples and strawberries.

qs.q: What is nectar?
o: A part of a bee's body
qs.why: 꽃에서 얻는 달콤한 즙을 nectar라고 해요.

qs.q: What do the bees inside the hive do?
qs.why: 안에 남은 벌들은 꿀을 만들어요.

qs.q: How do bees help plants?
qs.why: 꽃을 찾아다니며 식물이 씨앗과 열매를 만드는 것을 도와요.

qs.q: What would happen without bees?
qs.why: 벌이 없으면 사과, 딸기 같은 과일이 줄어들어요.

items.title: Tom's Diary
items.text: Monday, May 6. Today was a very busy day. In science class, our teacher showed us how a seed grows, and I put my bean seed near the window. After school, I went to the swimming pool with my cousin Jack. I was so tired that I fell asleep right after dinner. I hope my bean grows quickly!

qs.q: What did Tom learn in science class?
qs.why: 씨앗이 어떻게 자라는지 배웠어요.

qs.q: Who went to the swimming pool with Tom?
qs.why: 사촌 잭과 함께 수영장에 갔어요.

qs.q: Why did Tom fall asleep after dinner?
qs.why: 너무 피곤해서(so tired) 저녁 식사 후 바로 잠들었어요.

qs.q: What did Tom do first today?
qs.why: 과학 시간이 가장 먼저였고, 그다음 수영장, 저녁, 잠 순서예요.

items.title: At the Restaurant
items.text:
Waiter: Hello! Are you ready to order?
Mia: Yes, please. I'd like a cheese pizza.
Waiter: Would you like something to drink?
Mia: Orange juice, please.
Waiter: The pizza is nine dollars, and the juice is two dollars.
Mia: Oh, that is eleven dollars. Can I pay by card?
Waiter: Sure. Please pay at the counter after your meal.
Mia: Thank you.

qs.q: What does Mia order to eat?
qs.why: I'd like a cheese pizza라고 말해요.

qs.q: How much is the total?
qs.why: 피자 9달러와 주스 2달러를 더하면 11달러예요.

qs.q: How will Mia pay?
qs.why: 카드로 계산해도 되는지 물었고 웨이터가 Sure라고 답했어요.

qs.q: When should Mia pay?
qs.why: 식사 후에 계산대에서 내라고 했어요.

items.title: Weekend Plans
items.text:
Jun: Hi, Sora. Are you free this Saturday?
Sora: I have a piano lesson in the morning, but I'm free in the afternoon.
Jun: Great! My brother and I are going to fly kites at the river park. Do you want to come?
Sora: That sounds fun. What time?
Jun: How about two o'clock?
Sora: Okay. Should I bring anything?
Jun: Just a water bottle. We have a big kite for you to try.
Sora: Cool! See you at two.

qs.q: Why can't Sora meet Jun in the morning?
qs.why: 오전에는 피아노 수업이 있다고 했어요.

qs.q: Where will they fly kites?
qs.why: river park에서 연을 날릴 거예요.

qs.q: What should Sora bring?
qs.why: 물병만 가져오라고 했어요. 연은 준비되어 있어요.

qs.q: What time will they meet?
qs.why: 두 시에 만나기로 했어요.

qs.q: Who is going with Jun?
qs.why: My brother and I라고 말해요.

items.q: Read the sign: “Please keep off the grass.” What does the sign mean?
o: Please sit on the grass here.
Do not walk on the grass.
items.why: keep off는 ‘들어가지 않다’라는 뜻이라서 잔디에 들어가지 말라는 표지판이에요.

items.q: Look at the class schedule. Monday: Art / Tuesday: Music / Wednesday: P.E. / Thursday: English / Friday: Science. On which day do the students have English?
items.why: 시간표에서 English 옆에 Thursday라고 되어 있어요.

items.q: Mom: I'm at the market. Do we need eggs or milk? Dad: We have eggs, but there is no milk. What will Mom probably buy?
items.why: 달걀은 있고 우유가 없으므로 엄마는 우유를 살 거예요.

items.q: Mina lost her pencil case. Her friend found it under the desk and gave it back to her. In the second sentence, what does “it” mean?
items.why: it은 앞 문장의 pencil case를 가리켜요.

items.q: Read the steps. First, wash the rice. Next, put the rice and water in a pot. Then cook it for twenty minutes. Finally, let it rest for five minutes. What do you do right after putting the rice and water in a pot?
o: Let it rest for five minutes
items.why: Next 다음 단계가 Then이므로 20분 동안 익혀요.

items.q: The soup was too hot, so Ben waited for it to cool. In this sentence, “cool” means ___.
items.why: 너무 뜨거워서 기다렸으므로 cool은 식다라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 다음 글에서 ‘언제’에 해당하는 말은? “The school festival is on May 5 at the gym.”
items.why: 날짜를 나타내는 on May 5가 ‘언제’에 해당해요. at the gym은 ‘어디서’예요.

items.q: Read: “Ana has two cats. One is white and one is black. They both like fish.” Which sentence is true?
o: Both of the cats are white.
items.why: 한 마리는 흰색이고 한 마리는 검은색이므로 ‘한 마리는 흰색’이 맞아요.

items.q: Tim put on his coat, gloves, and hat before he went outside. What was the weather probably like?
items.why: 코트, 장갑, 모자를 쓴 것으로 보아 날씨가 추웠을 거예요.

items.q: Read: “Dogs need exercise every day. They also need food, water, and a warm place to sleep. Taking care of a dog takes time.” What is the main idea?
o: Dogs need a lot of care
Dogs eat only meat and bones
items.why: 개를 돌보려면 운동, 먹이, 잠자리 등 시간과 정성이 필요하다는 것이 중심 내용이에요.

items.q: Subject: New Test Day. “Hi class, our science test is moved from Tuesday to Thursday. Please study more!” What is this email about?
o: A class trip to a museum
items.why: 과학 시험 날짜가 화요일에서 목요일로 바뀐다는 내용이에요.

items.q: Menu: Sandwich 4,000 won / Salad 3,500 won / Soup 2,500 won / Juice 1,500 won. Sora has exactly 6,000 won. Which two things can she buy with exactly that money?
A movie starts at 3:30 p.m. and lasts 90 minutes. When does it end?
“Wow! I won first prize!” Jun shouted. How does Jun feel?
items.why: 1등을 해서 감탄하며 소리쳤으므로 신이 난 기분이에요.

items.q: Peter is taller than Jack, and Jack is taller than Sam. Who is the shortest?
items.why: Peter > Jack > Sam 순으로 키가 크므로 가장 작은 사람은 Sam이에요.

items.q: Read: “Bats sleep during the day and fly at night to find food. They sleep upside down in caves.” Which is the best title?
items.why: 박쥐가 어떻게 사는지 설명하는 글이므로 ‘박쥐의 생활’이 알맞아요.

items.q: Read: “Go straight for two blocks and turn left. The bakery is next to the bank.” Where is the bakery?
items.why: The bakery is next to the bank라고 나와요.

items.q: Kate ran to the bus stop, but the bus had already left. She walked to school and was late. Why was Kate late?
items.why: 버스가 이미 떠났으므로 버스를 놓쳐서 늦었어요.

items.good: Mina is taller than her brother.
bad: Mina is more tall than her brother.
Mina is tallest than her brother.
Mina is tall than her brother.
items.rule: 짧은 형용사의 비교급은 -er을 붙이고 than과 함께 써요.

items.good: We went to the zoo yesterday.
bad: We goed to the zoo yesterday.
We go to the zoo yesterday.
We going to the zoo yesterday.
items.rule: yesterday가 있으면 과거형을 써요. go의 과거형은 불규칙형 went예요.

items.good: He is going to visit his uncle this weekend.
items.ko: 그는 이번 주말에 삼촌을 방문할 거예요.
bad: He is go to visit his uncle this weekend.
He going to visit his uncle this weekend.
He is going visit his uncle this weekend.

cz.st: He is ___ to visit his uncle this weekend.

items.rule: 계획은 be going to + 동사원형으로 말해요.

items.good: What time does the library open?
bad: What time does the library opens?
What time do the library open?
items.rule: 의문사 의문문에서 주어가 3인칭 단수이면 does를 쓰고, 뒤의 동사는 원형으로 써요.

items.good: There are some books on the desk.
items.ko: 책상 위에 책 몇 권이 있어요.
bad: There is some books on the desk.
There are some book on the desk.
There be some books on the desk.

cz.st: There ___ some books on the desk.

items.rule: 복수 명사(books) 앞에서는 There are를 써요.
items.hint: 뒤에 오는 명사가 하나인지 여러 개인지 보세요.

items.good: My sister can't swim, but she can run fast.
items.ko: 내 여동생은 수영은 못하지만 빨리 달릴 수 있어요.
bad: My sister can't swims, but she can run fast.
My sister doesn't can swim, but she can run fast.
My sister can't swimming, but she can run fast.

cz.st: My sister can't ___, but she can run fast.

items.rule: can과 can't 뒤에는 항상 동사원형이 와요.
